items.title: Leonard Bocage Interview, 1972-03-24
items.q: Yeah, yeah, they had peck horn. Old man Pian played peck horn, and Georgia Hooker played, uh, baritone.

ctx.x: Yeah, but in the Excelsior, did they have baritone?
Yeah, yeah, they had peck horn. Old man Pian played peck horn, and Georgia Hooker played, uh, baritone. Mm-hmm.
Was he any kin to Joe Pian? For me?
